data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and fund pilot
data.body:
Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in 2 or 3 of the listed tickers.

On October 16, 2026, BMRC disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1403475/000140347526000041/bmrc-20261016.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
